cues.label: 02 · A data load is a business transformation

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «A data load is a business transformation». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar receives vehicles and appointments from a dealer management system, abbreviated DMS. The DMS stores each vehicle under a stable source identifier. Salesforce needs a reliable way to recognize that the same source vehicle has arrived again. A CSV row number is not such an identity: sorting or splitting the file changes it. An External ID field can support matching imported data to existing Salesforce records, but you must inspect its configuration and uniqueness requirements. The starter includes VIN__c; do not assume that any field named VIN is automatically the correct external identifier for every source. For the exercise, propose a Source_Key__c field with an explicit matching policy and document it as an extension.

cues.label: 03 · Preserve identity through every result file

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Preserve identity through every result file». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The supplied CSV contains six appointment input rows representing five distinct appointment identities. It does not contain vehicle rows. Create a separate five-row vehicle fixture with keys V-001 through V-005, leaving V-MISSING and V-MISSING-2 absent for the first attempt. The two A-101 rows are complete snapshots at versions 1 and 2. Before upload, retain version 2 and record version 1 as superseded. Do not submit competing versions together and assume CSV order makes the latest one win. Upsert matches identities; it does not supply a version policy. Bulk API results distinguish successful, failed, and unprocessed records. Failed means processing encountered an error. Unprocessed means processing did not take place, such as when a job is interrupted. These categories need different operational explanations even if both eventually require attention. Do not rely on returned result ordering matching the original CSV order.

The example on screen is Synthetic appointment input; source keys are fictional. Before running it, identify the input, the branch that makes the decision, and the result we expect. We will compare that expectation with the actual output.

ЭКРАН. Раздел «Control replays and concurrency». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

After correcting a missing parent, repeat only the relevant failed or unprocessed work unless your entire operation is deliberately idempotent and a broader replay is justified. Use the same business identity for a retry of the same action. Assigning a new random key on every attempt defeats duplicate detection. Choose the API and loading mechanism explicitly. Bulk API 2.0 handles batching for you; do not assume that every tuning option from the original Bulk API exists there. If your design requires a serial-processing capability, verify which supported tool or API provides it. Alternatively, coordinate independent jobs or change the data partition with full awareness of how the service processes them.

cues.label: 05 · Make the exercise reproducible without a large org

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Make the exercise reproducible without a large org». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A few synthetic records are enough to demonstrate matching, dependencies, rejected rows, and a replay. Use a local spreadsheet ledger if no suitable org is available. Mark predicted outcomes as predictions. If you execute a small load, save sanitized result rows and the precise metadata configuration that controls matching. Before a real migration, add preparation steps for backups, permissions, source cutover, user communication, and reconciliation ownership. Those are decisions to review with the responsible team, not instructions to run against an employer's org. Retain result artifacts according to the agreed operational policy rather than assuming the API keeps them forever.
For the practical work, define Source_Key__c and uniqueness assumptions on the proposed parent and child extensions; keep the lookup relationship unchanged.

Before you finish, answer this question in your own words. How is an unprocessed row different from a failed row?

A failed row was attempted and encountered an error; an unprocessed row did not undergo processing in that job attempt. Save your work with the expected and actual results. If a check was not run, say which one remains and what you would need to run it.
